## Sheet C4 — Cà chua + Bí ngô

- Lưu thành: `art_inbox/.batch/garden-04-crops/C4.png`
- Đính kèm (theo thứ tự): `1_style_flora.png`
- Kết quả: lưới 2×4: crop_tomato_sprout, crop_tomato_grow, crop_tomato_ripe, crop_tomato_wilt, crop_pumpkin_sprout, crop_pumpkin_grow, crop_pumpkin_ripe, crop_pumpkin_wilt

```text
Image 1 is the STYLE REFERENCE: finished art from my game. Copy its art style exactly: a dark warm-brown outline (never black) of even weight, soft cel shading with one shadow tone and one highlight tone, light from the top-left, warm pastel colours of medium saturation, a subtle painted texture, rounded chunky friendly shapes, low-to-medium detail. Do NOT copy the objects of image 1.

Draw ONE image: a sheet of 8 separate game sprites in a clean grid of 2 row(s) x 4 column(s), in exactly this order, left to right, top to bottom:
Row 1: (1) Tomato sprout: two small fuzzy green seed leaves; (2) Tomato growing: a young bushy tomato plant tied to a short wooden stake, tiny yellow flowers, no fruit yet; (3) Tomato ripe: a leafy tomato plant on a wooden stake with clusters of plump shiny red tomatoes with green star tops; (4) Tomato wilted: the plant slumped on its stake, dry brown leaves, one shrivelled tomato.
Row 2: (1) Pumpkin sprout: two round green seed leaves and one small curly tendril; (2) Pumpkin growing: a low vine with big round leaves and one yellow trumpet flower; (3) Pumpkin ripe: a big round ribbed orange pumpkin sitting on the ground under broad green leaves and a curly vine; (4) Pumpkin wilted: dry brown curled leaves over a small pale soft pumpkin.
Each plant is seen from the side and slightly above, standing upright; its stem ends at the bottom in a very small mound of soil. No pot, no grass patch, no ground, no cloud platform.
Each row is ONE crop plant in 4 growth stages drawn at the SAME scale: 1 sprout (tiny, two or three leaves), 2 growing (young leafy plant, about half height, nothing to harvest yet), 3 ripe (fully grown and ready to harvest, tallest, the crop clearly visible), 4 wilted (the ripe plant drooping, dry yellow-brown leaves, about the height of stage 2). Keep the same colours and leaf shape across the row.

Every object is fully visible and centred in its own cell, with wide empty gaps between objects; nothing touches, overlaps or crosses into another cell. Wide landscape image.
Background: one plain flat light-grey colour (#C8C8C8) everywhere. No gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast shadow on the background.
No text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, watermark, logo, border or frame. Not glossy, not a 3D render, not flat vector, not pixel art. No glow, no sparkles, no floating particles.
```
